page: Microsoft Azure D64nds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Dndv6 server family. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features an x86_64 architecture with 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage needs, the D64nds_v6 includes 3780 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-speed external storage options. The instance is designated as network-optimized, though it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard GPUs associated with this configuration.

No benchmark data is available for this specific instance type, meaning direct performance metrics cannot be verified. Qualitatively, the hardware profile offers a high resource density with a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local NVMe storage. This configuration provides a balanced cost-efficiency profile for workloads requiring significant local storage and dedicated compute resources without the added expense of specialized GPU hardware.

Given its balanced resource allocation, network optimization, and large local NVMe SSD storage, the D64nds_v6 is designed for general-purpose workloads, database hosting, and applications requiring fast local scratch space. It is also suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, and data processing tasks that benefit from dedicated Intel processor cores and high-speed local storage.
